# FunctionalityPruning

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The selective removal of network elements that do not contribute to the system's primary functional goals, based on real-time relevance metrics. Reduces computational and communication overhead in neuromorphic and topological systems, allowing for scalable, self-maintaining architectures.
